corrections: Assumption: the model uses the explicit level-balance equations from 09_07_legacy_tank_demo.txt as the authoritative plant physics instead of a Modelica.Fluid network, because the brief provides those equations directly and does not provide a head-dependent hydraulic law or enough fluid-component sizing data to derive one without inventing additional physics.

Assumption: valve stroke times of 0.8 s open and 0.6 s close are retained as parameters in the brief but are not converted into intermediate flow dynamics, because the brief states only Boolean open/closed commands and provides no approved relationship between command and partial-opening effective flow.
Assumption from the merged brief retained: command pulse width is set to 0.2 s, equal to 2*scanPeriod, so the 0.1 s PLC scan can observe every scheduled momentary command.

Assumption: a small physical floor of 1e-6 m is used only in the T2 drain cutoff condition to prevent draining below zero; this floor is strictly below the stated low-level threshold 0.05 m so the threshold remains crossable.

Assumption: transfer outflow from TK-101 is cut off when tank1_level_m <= 0 to enforce non-negative inventory; the stated low-level threshold for transition remains 0.05 m, which is above that physical floor.
